data.title: Two days of practical talks for developers, in Edinburgh
data.subtitle: DevNorth brings together 600 engineers on 14 and 15 May 2027 to share what works in production: real systems, real mistakes and the lessons that came out of them.

questions.question: Where does DevNorth take place?
questions.answer: At a conference centre ten minutes from Waverley station. We will send the exact address, directions and accessibility information with your ticket.

questions.question: Can I get a refund?
questions.answer: Tickets can be refunded in full up to 30 days before the event and transferred to a colleague at any time.

questions.question: Will the talks be recorded?
questions.answer: Yes. Every main-stage talk is recorded and sent to ticket holders about two weeks after the conference.

questions.question: Is there a code of conduct?
questions.answer: Yes. DevNorth is a welcoming event for everyone, and our code of conduct is available on the site with a contact for reports.
